brief: The canvas displays a captivating, complex steampunk sculpture centered around a rotating cube. Multiple splines, made of tarnished copper and deep emerald glass, orbit slowly around the central piece. The glass tracery contains visible, internal energy veins and deep crystalline structures, which glow with deep bioluminescent patterns. These patterns are not static; they exhibit slow, visible crystalline growth structures and shift subtly throughout the scene. The overall composition is highly detailed, showcasing intricate metallic components set against the glowing, evolving emerald lattice.
